title: Мини-Проект: "Мой Трудный День" (Продукт)
description: Напиши 5 предложений о том, как долго ты что-то делал вчера, и какой у тебя был результат.
topic: Напиши 5 предложений о том, как долго ты что-то делал вчера, и какой у тебя был результат. (I had been doing homework for 3 hours before I went for a walk. I was very tired.)

conditions.label: Форма had been + глагол с -ing
conditions.hint: I had been doing homework for 3 hours before I went for a walk.

conditions.label: Маркеры for / since / before
conditions.hint: for 3 hours, since morning, before I went for a walk

sentences: I had been studying for my exams for four hours before I finally took a break, and I was completely exhausted.
I had been working on my project since morning before I finished it in the evening, so I felt very relieved.
I had been cleaning my room for two hours before my friends arrived, and I was sweaty but happy.
I had been cooking dinner for an hour before my family came home, and I was really hungry.
I had been walking my dog for thirty minutes before it started raining, so I was wet and cold.
